what: Fades up from 40px below over .9s as it enters the screen — for things that follow one another such as question cards and case-text blocks. Given a percentage (30%), it rises by that ratio of its own height.

options.fade-dur: Opacity-only duration (seconds) — if given it runs separately from position, default same as duration (Place position 1s · opacity 1.4s)
options.y: Rise distance, default 40 (px) — like 24 or 30%, with a unit (-2rem, 3vw) it uses that unit — negative comes down from above (Brand -2rem)
options.stagger: Gap between child lines (seconds) — if given, the children rise one after another instead of the element, and run only once (Brand verse .14)
options.x: Distance coming in from the side (px), default 0 — Brand text block 36 (2em) · add % for a ratio of its own width (Site 8%)
options.blur: Initial blur (px), default 0 — if given, the blur clears separately (Brand value 1)
options.blur-dur: Length in seconds for the blur to clear, same as the default duration (brand .5)
options.y-narrow: Rise distance in windows 1023px and below — if absent, y stays as is (brand 8)
options.bright: Initial brightness — given with blur, it clears to 1 together with the blur (Brand photo slot 1.15), default none
options.back: If on, it disappears with the same length and curve when scrolling back above the start line (by default, once shown it stays) — not used together with stagger · Brand section fade
options.base: Initial opacity, default 0 — e.g. .05 (something blurry settles from above and sharpens)
options.scale: Starting scale, default 1 (none) — Brand 1.05 (slightly bigger, settling from above to its own size)
options.alpha: For opacity, visibility is not hidden and only transparency moves (default autoAlpha) — for when hover·click must work even before fading in (Brand notification row·column cards)
options.rotate: Initial tilt (deg), default 0 — Brand B text block 2 (even-numbered elements x: -3; rotate: -2)
options.fade-ease: Curve for opacity and blur only — runs separately from the offset (y), same as the default ease (0.55,0.085,0.68,0.53)
options.fade-delay: Delay for opacity only (seconds) — same as the default delay (Brand-zero .1, position delay .15)
options.blur-delay: Blur-only delay (s), defaults to the same as delay
options.again: If the element’s top edge moves farther below the top of the screen than screen height × this value (scrolling back up a lot), it is hidden again, and it appears again after scrolling down past the start line — it turns on only when scrolling down, and when scrolling up past the start line it is left as is (brand 1.5)
